question: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan is a flagship programme of the government of India, that was started in 2001 to achieve ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Universalisation of Elementary Education (UEE)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) is the Government of India's flagship program for achieving Universalisation of Elementary Education (UEE).
 
• Launched in 2001, SSA aims to provide free and compulsory education to children aged 6-14 years.
 
• The program focuses on bridging gender and social gaps in education.
 
• SSA is aligned with the mandate of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009, which makes education a fundamental right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009:**

 
 
• Ensures free and compulsory education for children aged 6-14 years in India.
 
• Mandates 25% reservation for disadvantaged sections in private schools.
 
• Sets norms and standards for pupil-teacher ratios, infrastructure, and teacher qualifications.
 
 
 
• **Mid-Day Meal Scheme:**
 
 
• Provides free lunches on working days for children in primary and upper primary classes.
 
• Aims to improve nutritional status of children and encourage school attendance.
 
 
 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**
 
 
• Aims to overhaul the Indian education system and improve the quality of education.
 
• Focuses on early childhood care and education, foundational literacy, and numeracy.
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA):**
 
 
• Launched in 2009 to enhance access to secondary education and improve its quality.
 
• Aims to achieve a gross enrollment ratio of 100% in secondary education by 2030.
